scenes.text: What if the Sun vanished for exactly one second?
You would not notice for eight minutes.
That is how long light takes to cross the gap.
Then the sky would go dark - and Earth would keep flying straight.
Not falling. Not burning. Just leaving.
Follow What If Physics for more.
